result_sets.summary: For the same fixed H4 chain at 1.0 Angstrom, STO-3G, DF rank 12, Hamiltonian hash 56e4df83...31e5, and CA/10 task, WP03 changes only the PF coefficient among the H_D-only surrogate C_D, paper-D6, and dominant-eigenphase values while holding the WP04 allocation, compiled-RZ schedule selection, and q=1,2-calibrated cost provider fixed. C_D is refitted over the same conditioned delta window 0.05/0.1/0.2/0.4 used for the D6/dominant comparison. L_D=0 is retained only as a coefficient counterexample because WP01-S screened it out before comparable compiled-cost evaluation: C_D is zero there while paper-D6 is 0.0115338 and the dominant coefficient is 0.0114931. At L_D=3, common-window C_D is 12.50% below paper-D6; at L_D=12 it is 0.115% above. The paper-D6 versus dominant coefficient gap is at most 0.317% over the two costed candidates. All 18 coefficient/L_D/delta scenarios are feasible, and every policy selects L_D=12, delta=0.02 at the point estimate. Selecting L_D=3, delta=0.02 has 5.216% point regret under paper-D6, but its local 5% plus calibration relative-gap scenario is [-15.91%, 28.57%] and its 25% transfer scenario is [-46.20%, 90.91%], so coefficient choice does not resolve the WP04 interval overlap. Paper-D6 coefficient headroom to the delta=0.02 PF-budget boundary is 6.76% at L_D=3 and 6.55% at L_D=12. Stored D6 and dominant signed biases use opposite recorded signs, and individual mixed/tail commutator terms are not decomposed, so no signed cancellation claim is made. This is a model-conditional long-q affine screening result, not a PF certification, statistical coefficient distribution, full-scope holdout, or final total-cost comparison.
